About Inspira Education

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities.

As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide.

As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub).

The Role

We are seeking a BS/MD Admissions Consultant with prior admissions committee experience and a strong understanding of the BS/MD, direct medical, and competitive undergraduate admissions process. This role is ideal for physicians who are passionate about mentorship, education, and helping high-achieving students navigate BS/MD applications. This is a part-time, remote, 1099 contract role that can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada.

Responsibilities

  • Guide prospective BS/MD and direct medical program applicants through the admissions process, including school selection, application strategy, essays, resumes, recommendations, timelines, and interviews
  • Help students strengthen their academic and extracurricular profiles and develop compelling application materials
  • Support students in researching and evaluating best-fit BS/MD, pre-med, and undergraduate programs aligned with their goals and interests
  • Provide guidance and feedback on personal statements, supplemental essays, and interview preparation while helping students maintain an authentic voice
  • Support students with project planning, application timeline management, and progress tracking through internal organizational tools
  • Stay up to date on BS/MD, direct medical, pre-med, and undergraduate admissions trends to provide timely and strategic guidance

Qualifications

  • MD or DO degree required
  • Prior admissions committee experience at the undergraduate or medical school level
  • Experience mentoring high school students, particularly in academic advising or college application support
  • Familiarity with BS/MD, direct medical, and pre-med admissions processes, including school selection, application strategy, and interview preparation
  • Proven success guiding students through competitive undergraduate admissions
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple students and timelines
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

For more information about our company, please visit our website: Inspira Education Group.

Inspira Education Group does not discriminate based on race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other reason prohibited by law in providing employment opportunities and benefits.

Role Summary

Accepted, a Guidewell Education brand, is a premier admissions consulting firm providing one-on-one guidance to applicants navigating college, graduate, MBA, law, med, and healthcare admissions.

Guidewell Education is seeking experienced Medical/Healthcare School Admissions Consultants (1099 Independent Contractors). Consultants provide expert guidance to aspiring medical/healthcare students while maintaining flexibility over their own availability and client intake.

Scope of Services

  • Work one-on-one with applicants, helping them navigate the admissions process, which could include school selection, brainstorming, primary and secondary application revisions, personal statement editing, work activity/experience description revisions, resume construction and editing, interview preparation, waitlist strategy, and decision counseling.
  • Conduct free introductory consultations with prospective applicants to discuss goals and initial questions.
  • Prepare for client sessions independently and deliver services aligned with agreed-upon professional and privacy standards.
  • Maintain basic service records necessary for billing, compliance, and client continuity.

Availability & Client Scheduling

  • Contractors set their own schedule and capacity.
  • Due to client demand, candidates with the capacity for 15 hours per week or more during peak application cycles are preferred. Availability does not guarantee client volume.
  • Contractors manage their own calendars directly with clients to ensure agreed-upon package deadlines and deliverables are met.
  • Contractors remain free to provide services to other clients or businesses, subject to standard confidentiality and non-conflict obligations.

Contractor Qualifications

  • Expert knowledge of the medical school or healthcare program application process.
  • An MD or DO is highly desired.
  • Preferred Expertise: Deep familiarity with centralized application services (e.g., AMCAS, AACOMAS, CASPA, TMDSAS).
  • Desired Experience: Prior roles directing or advising within university pre-health or postbaccalaureate programs, or specialized experience supporting non-traditional applicants and those with complex academic histories.
  • Desired Previous Roles: Former medical/healthcare school admissions committee members, admissions officers, admissions chairs, or faculty members.
  • Exceptional writing, structural editing, and proofreading skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage project deadlines, and communicate effectively in written and verbal formats.

What Successful Service Looks Like

  • Delivery of high-quality consulting that meets client objectives and program standards.
  • Timely, direct communication with clients and administrative contacts.
  • Positive client feedback and structured progress toward agreed-upon application goals.

Contractor Compensation

  • Contractor Rate: Competitive revenue-share model (45% of the net client package price) OR a $165/hour flat rate for hourly services.
  • Ancillary Projects: Optional non-client deliverables (e.g., writing and revising blog posts, leading and/or participating in podcasts, video initiatives, or peer-reviewing materials) are compensated at $75/hour.
  • Optional platform orientation and administrative setup sessions are provided uncompensated prior to accepting client engagements.
  • No minimum number of clients or hours is guaranteed. Contractors are responsible for their own business expenses and tax obligations.

What to Expect from the Contractor Selection Process

  • Application/Interest Review: Review of relevant experience, subject-matter expertise, and role fit by our Talent Team.
  • Talent Conversation: A video conversation covering service fit, contractor model, compensation, logistics, and availability.
  • Role-Specific Evaluation: Completion of a writing and editing exercise, followed by a team interview utilizing an evaluation rubric.
  • Confirmation Chat: Final discussion of service expectations, client needs, and role fit with a Guidewell program leader.

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is intended to be structured as an independent contractor relationship rather than employment. Contractors are not eligible for Guidewell employee benefits and are responsible for their own tax obligations and business expenses except as otherwise provided in a written agreement. The specific terms of any client work will be governed by the applicable independent contractor agreement. Nothing in this posting should be read to alter the actual nature of the working relationship or applicable law.

About Guidewell Education & Our Core Values

Guidewell Education is a mission-driven organization representing a family of successful legacy brands in the education sector. Our mission is to deliver best-in-class, transformational educational experiences and resources, guiding every student with empathy and expertise.

Our portfolio includes some of the most trusted names in the educational services space, such as Applerouth Education, Summit Educational Group, ESM Prep, College MatchPoint, mbaMission, Reach Cambridge, and Guidewell Global. Together, we provide a comprehensive suite of services including academic tutoring, standardized test preparation, executive function coaching, college counseling, graduate admissions, and summer enrichment.

Across our brands, we guide students and families at every stage of their academic journey. Our team is dedicated to helping students and professionals define their goals, develop confidence in their abilities, and achieve their full potential.

Our Culture & Values At Guidewell Education, we're guided by values that shape how we support students and work together as colleagues - we are student-centered, empathetic, expert practitioners, and growth-oriented. These principles show up in every coaching relationship we build and every decision we make. You can read more about how our team lives these values at.

Diversity and Inclusion:

We believe that diversity and inclusion enrich education and drive success. We are committed to ensuring that all people who interact with Guidewell Education--parents, students, team members, contractors, partners, vendors--are respected and valued holistically. We actively seek to engage contractors and talent from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and experiences because we believe that diversity fuels innovation and education to new heights.

The Legal Stuff:

Candidates will be evaluated for contract opportunities on the basis of their qualifications, expertise, and ability to perform the services requested. Guidewell Education does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, genetics, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or status as a covered veteran under applicable state or federal laws.

To express interest in this independent contractor opportunity, please submit your resume highlighting your admissions expertise.

The Opportunity

We’re seeking experienced Former Admissions Officers (FAOs) to join our global team. FAOs bring insider admissions expertise to students throughout their high school journey, from candidacy assessments to application review, to help them strengthen their university applications and understand the admissions review process.

This is not a case management role — you’ll focus exclusively on the admissions expertise that only experienced readers and officers can provide.

What You’ll Do

  • Written Application Reviews: Deliver structured, actionable feedback using Crimson’s review templates.

  • Mock Admissions Committees (VIP): Join FAO panels to simulate real admissions deliberations and provide debrief insights.

  • Collaborate with Strategists: Work alongside Crimson’s Student Success Managers and Strategists to align on each student’s roadmap.

Who We’re Looking For

Non-Negotiable Requirements

  • Former undergraduate admissions officers, readers, or senior admissions leaders from Top 30 US university, with experience evaluating and/or making admissions decisions.

  • U.S. campus experience (undergraduate level only).

  • Experience evaluating and/or making admissions decisions for domestic and/or international applicants

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience from Top 15 / Ivy-Plus institutions (Premier FAO = Ivies + Stanford + MIT).

  • Experience reading both domestic and international territories.

  • Strong, warm communication skills suited to working with high school students and parents.

  • Ability to provide clear, honest, and actionable feedback with empathy and professionalism.

Why Join Crimson

  • Flexible Schedule: Choose your own hours and workload; fully remote.

  • No Case Management: Focus solely on admissions expertise — we handle operations and client coordination.

  • Continuous Client Stream: Work with students year-round, especially during peak admissions cycles.

  • Global Reach: Support diverse students across 50+ countries.

  • Top-of-Market Pay: Competitive hourly and per-review rates that reflect your institutional background and expertise.

  • Network:Join a global network of FAOs from top U.S. universities.

Role Details

  • Type: Independent contractor (remote, part-time, or seasonal).

  • Timing: Year-round or seasonal engagement, with peak work between September–January.

  • Compensation: Highly competitive rates based on experience and school background.

Join Our Network

Become part of a distinguished global team of 40+ FAOs who’ve collectively made over 100,000 admissions decisions at the world’s most selective universities.
Your insights can help shape the next generation of world leaders — while maintaining full flexibility and professional autonomy.

Join the ACI Learning Adventure!

Our Mission

Welcome to a new era of learning, where individuals and organizations come to transform goals into measurable success. At ACI Learning, we believe that anything worth doing is worth leading the way—with innovation, exceptional experiences, and impactful results.

We provide a full ecosystem of learning and development solutions that empower people and businesses to lead with confidence, learn with purpose, and achieve outcomes that matter. Join us, and together, we'll shape the future of skill-building and professional growth.

The ACI Team

Imagine collaborating with over 200 of the brightest minds who are passionate, grounded, and dedicated to shaping the future of eLearning. Together, we're not just a team; we're a movement in one of the most exciting times in tech.

Purpose-Driven Culture

At ACI Learning, work isn’t just a job. It’s a passion we pour into every project, every day. We celebrate creativity, innovation, and the joy of doing what we love.

Your Opportunity

Are you ready to be part of something transformative? Dive into a world of collaboration, growth, and endless potential. Apply now and help lead the change!

Who We Are

ACI Learning is a leading provider of audit, cybersecurity and IT training solutions, empowering individuals and organizations worldwide to improve their technical capabilities and their cybersecurity with compelling and comprehensive training. Our leadership position extends even further to our new SaaS Learning Platform myACI that goes beyond audit, cyber and IT training to provide organizational and individual knowledge assessment, analytics and training delivery with integrated AI to understand capabilities and skill gaps for organizations.

About This Role

ACI Tech Academy is expanding its reach through campus and university partnership programs, and this role sits at the heart of that growth. As an Admissions Advisor supporting our national campus and university partnerships, you'll be the first real human touchpoint for prospective students who arrive through those channels — students who are often in an active decision-making moment, weighing real tradeoffs, and looking for someone they can trust to help them get it right.

This is not an order-taker role. It's consultative, fast-paced, and goal-driven. You'll be working a high-volume pipeline of inbound leads from partner campuses and universities, guiding prospective students through a structured admissions process, and building the kind of enrollment consistency that makes this program credible with our institutional partners. If you've got the drive to win, the discipline to stay organized across a big pipeline, and the genuine desire to help people make smart decisions about their futures, this is a role worth looking at closely.

What You'll Do

  • Own a high-volume pipeline of inbound leads sourced from our campus and university partnerships, from initial inquiry through enrollment
  • Serve as the primary contact for prospective students, providing clear, honest guidance on programs, tuition, funding options, and admissions requirements
  • Conduct individual admissions consultations to assess each student's goals, readiness, and fit for ACI Tech Academy's programs
  • Set accurate expectations about what it takes to succeed in our fast-paced, certification-focused programs, with a direct impact on on-time graduation outcomes
  • Maintain thorough, accurate records of all student interactions and enrollment activity in our CRM, with consistent outreach cadence and follow-up discipline
  • Represent ACI Tech Academy with integrity in all student and partner-facing interactions, in full alignment with ACI's core values
  • Participate in occasional evening or weekend events in support of prospective student engagement through campus and university partners

What You'll Need

Minimum qualifications:

  • 1 to 2 years of experience in admissions, enrollment, sales, or a comparable consultative role
  • Strong work ethic, high energy, and self-motivation you can demonstrate from day one
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, goal-driven environment with consistent outreach expectations
  • CRM discipline and organizational habits that hold up under volume
  • Professional communication skills and personal accountability that don't require external management

Preferred qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Prior experience advising or enrolling self-pay or consumer-financed students
  • Familiarity with VA Education Benefits and how they apply to non-traditional education programs
  • Background in higher education, admissions, or academic partnership environments

What We're Looking For

The best version of this person walks in ready to run. They're organized without being reminded, energetic without being told, and accountable in the quiet moments when no one's watching. They care about the student on the other end of the call, and that care shows up in how they listen, how they follow through, and how they handle a "not yet" without losing their footing.

We can teach the specifics. The admissions process, program details, how to navigate financing conversations, how to ask better questions. What we can't teach is the hunger to get better, the discipline to stay consistent when the pipeline gets heavy, or the genuine desire to help someone make a decision that changes their trajectory. That part has to come with you.

If you've been in a fast-paced, goal-driven environment before and you know what it feels like to own your outcomes, you'll find familiar ground here. If you're newer to this kind of work but bring coachability and the drive to close the gap quickly, we want to hear from you too. The thing that matters most is that you show up ready to learn, ready to move, and ready to be honest with students even when the honest answer is the harder one to give.

At ACI Learning, we offer a competitive, experience-driven salary range that aligns with your qualifications and contributions. To that end, the posted salary range reflects our most reasonable assumption of pay for this position at the time of posting.

Pay range
$55,000—$70,000 USD

Why ACI Learning is Your Next Big Move

For Full-Time, Benefits Eligible Positions

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage—starting the 1st of the month after your hire date.

Four weeks of paid parental or medical leave, so you can focus on what matters most.

Flexible PTO policy, sick time, and eight paid holidays — because we believe in balance.

401(k) retirement plan so you can invest in your future from day one.

One free course each year after 90 days — advancing your skills is part of the job.

Tuition assistance to support your continued education and professional growth.

Key Responsibilities

Intake & Admissions

  • Handle incoming calls from prospective patients and families.
  • Build rapport and create a supportive, professional experience from the first interaction.
  • Ask thoughtful questions to understand the caller’s needs and circumstances.
  • Guide qualified and motivated prospects through the intake and admissions process.
  • Clearly explain next steps and help callers move forward where appropriate.
  • Recognise when a caller needs empathy and support versus when a more direct approach is needed.
  • Handle sensitive, emotional, and sometimes difficult conversations calmly and professionally.

Follow-Up & Lead Management

  • Follow up consistently with prospective patients who may take several days or weeks to make a decision.
  • Maintain accurate lead information and follow-up activity in the CRM.
  • Track conversations, next steps, and outstanding information.
  • Make sure motivated prospects don't fall through the cracks.
  • Maintain persistence while remaining respectful and empathetic.

Documentation & Handoffs

  • Enter detailed and accurate notes into the CRM/EMR.
  • Keep patient and prospect information organised and up to date.
  • Document conversations, relevant information, and next steps clearly.
  • Ensure clean and complete handoffs to the weekday admissions team.
  • Follow established intake and documentation procedures.

Requirements

You must have previous experience in a phone-based, intake, admissions, healthcare, customer service, sales, or similar role.

We're looking for someone with:

  • Strong professional phone skills.
  • Experience speaking with customers, patients, families, clients, or prospects by phone.
  • Strong communication and active listening skills.
  • Excellent organisation and attention to detail.
  • Experience using CRM systems.
  • The ability to learn new CRM/EMR systems quickly.
  • Strong documentation and note-taking skills.
  • Excellent follow-through and persistence.
  • Ability to manage multiple leads and conversations at different stages.
  • Confidence handling difficult, emotional, or sensitive conversations.
  • Ability to work independently without constant supervision.
  • Reliable availability for overnight weekend shifts.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in any of the following would be particularly valuable:
    • Behavioral health
    • Mental health
    • Rehabilitation
    • Healthcare intake
    • Patient coordination
    • Admissions
    • Case management
    • Medical call centres
    • Patient/customer support
    • Consultative sales
    • High-touch customer service

Empathy & Judgment

You’ll be dealing with a sensitive population, so you need to be able to read the situation and understand when someone needs reassurance, patience, and empathy versus when they need clear direction and encouragement to take the next step.

Strong Phone Communication

You should be confident and natural on the phone, able to build trust quickly, ask the right questions, explain information clearly, and guide callers through the intake process.

Organisation & Documentation

You need to be extremely organised. Accurate CRM/EMR notes, clear documentation, follow-ups, and handoffs are a major part of the role.

Persistence & Follow-Through

Prospective patients may not make a decision immediately. You need to be comfortable following up over a one- to two-week period and keeping track of where each prospect is in the process.

Difficult Conversations

You should be comfortable speaking with people who may be upset, distressed, frustrated, or hesitant, while remaining calm, professional, and compassionate.
